findings.title: Interrupted-recording recovery has no automated test and no end-to-end proof
findings.root_cause: recoverInterruptedRecording() exists in src/lib/recorder.ts but nothing drives it through a crash/restart cycle in CI or in this audit.
findings.reproduction: Crash the app mid-recording; relaunch; observe recovery — manual only, unscripted.
findings.impact: Data-loss path for the product's most important promise (a recording is never lost) is unproven.
findings.fix: Add a unit test that seeds AsyncStorage with an ACTIVE_KEY fixture and asserts the recovery enqueue + saveActive(null).

findings.title: Live OAuth round-trips unverified; Google rejects the local private-IP redirect
findings.root_cause: Redirect URIs are not registered in provider consoles for the local address; Google returns 400 invalid_request (device_id/device_name required for private IP).
findings.evidence: publicApiBaseUrl() builds callbacks from PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL/EXTERNAL_SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_URL; /calendar/providers returns ["google"], /connect/available returns ["slack","google_docs"].
findings.impact: Calendar/Slack/Docs/Procore connections cannot be proven working end-to-end.
findings.fix: Expose the server via a public HTTPS origin (cloudflared/domain), set PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, register {origin}/functions/v1/{calendar,connect,procore}/callback in each console, then retest.

findings.title: Provider credentials were pasted into chat and are unrotated
findings.root_cause: Operational process, not code. Google, Slack, Procore, HubSpot tokens/secrets shared in conversation.
findings.evidence: git grep for secret shapes finds only doc placeholders; .env/.env.local/supabase/functions/.env gitignored.
findings.impact: Any secret exposed in chat must be treated as public.
findings.fix: Rotate every credential; move to a secret manager; never paste secrets in chat.

findings.title: OneNote/Salesforce OAuth configured but unverified (no credentials)
findings.fix: Provide MICROSOFT_* and SALESFORCE_* credentials and register redirects.

findings.title: Telephony provider mismatch: repo targets RingCentral; provided creds are Aircall/Twilio-shaped
findings.impact: Phone-calls feature unusable until a provider decision is made.
findings.fix: Either supply RINGCENTRAL_CLIENT_ID/SECRET or scope an Aircall-native import path.

findings.title: Settings save/rollback has no automated UI test
findings.impact: The saved-indicator and rollback path is only manually verified.
findings.fix: Add a component test or scripted E2E for the saved/rollback states.

findings.title: OAuth client secrets for Notion/Atlassian/Asana/Linear/monday/ClickUp/Trello have no server-side home
findings.root_cause: Architecture: these providers connect by user-pasted personal token in this codebase.
findings.impact: Cannot offer server-mediated OAuth for those providers without new architecture.
findings.fix: Decide: keep token-paste (current) or build an OAuth-client registry.

findings.title: Search filters (date/project/type) not present in UI
findings.impact: Search works but lacks filters the remediation prompt listed.

findings.title: Webhook delivery records only the last attempt; no retry/backoff queue
findings.impact: A failed delivery is visible but not retried automatically.
findings.fix: Add a delivery-log table + scheduled retry with backoff.

findings.title: No performance measurements taken
findings.fix: Measure render/pagination with a seeded dataset.

findings.title: Branch never pushed; 60 uncommitted reformat files; 4 trailing-whitespace lines
findings.fix: Push both branches; commit audit docs; tidy whitespace.
